simple.summary: נוֹד (Nôwd) means Nod , the land of Cain First listed occurrence: Gen 4 16.

definitions.full: H5113. Nod II. נוֺד apparently proper name, of a territory ׳ארץנֿ Gen 4:16 of region into which Cain wandered (compare 4:12 ; 4:14 ); ᵐ5 (strangely) Ναιδ ; ᵑ9 appellative, profugus in terra, compare Symm Theod, see Ne Marg. 9 .
